speaker: Priya
text: Morning, everyone — grab a seat, we're starting. This is the kickoff for the Q3 platform push. I want to walk out of here with owners and dates on three things: the auth migration, the ingestion cache, and mobile offline.

speaker: Sam
text: Quick heads-up before we dive in — the staging cluster is being rebuilt this morning, so if your deploys hang, that's why. It's not a you problem.

speaker: Priya
text: Noted. Okay, auth first. Marco, where did you land after last week's spike?

speaker: Marco
text: I compared rolling our own OAuth2 server against Auth0 and Okta. Building it ourselves is a three-month yak shave, and Okta's onboarding was painful in the trial. Auth0 gets us standards-compliant OAuth2 with the least ceremony.

speaker: Chen
text: Wait — sorry, before you commit — does Auth0 have a decent iOS SDK? I am not hand-rolling token refresh on mobile again.

speaker: Marco
text: It does, native SDKs on both platforms, token refresh included. So yeah, let's call it: we migrate the auth service to OAuth2 on Auth0. I'll own the migration end to end, and I'm targeting August 20 for the cutover.

speaker: Priya
text: Auth0, Marco owns it, August 20. Locked. Next — Sam, ingestion.

speaker: Sam
text: Transcript ingestion is hammering Postgres. Every segment lookup is a round trip, and it's the slowest part of the pipeline by a mile. We need a cache in front of it.

speaker: Priya
text: Agreed, so here's the call: we put a Redis cache in front of transcript ingestion. Sam, you own the cache layer, and let's target August 10 so it lands before the auth work peaks.

speaker: Sam
text: Works for me. I'll spin up a benchmark harness first so we get before-and-after numbers instead of vibes.

speaker: Chen
text: On mobile — field agents keep losing connectivity in basements and parking garages, and the app is a brick when that happens. I want us to scope a real offline mode.

speaker: Priya
text: It matters, no argument. What's the concrete next step?

speaker: Chen
text: I'll draft the offline mode spec this week — sync strategy, conflict handling, storage budget — and bring it to this group for review before we commit to any build work.

speaker: Marco
text: Can the spec also cover what happens to auth tokens when the device is offline? Asking for a friend who got paged about it twice.

speaker: Priya
text: Put it in the spec. Recap: Auth0 migration under Marco for August 20, Redis cache under Sam for August 10, Chen drafting the offline spec. Rate limiting stays parked until someone screams. Go build.
